note (M34, PLAN.md 49): M34 (FIXED, PLAN.md 49.4): the guide line is drawn on every lane. It was never a GX_LINES: fn_1_58E4's hook draws one 3000x200 quad twice from a recorded display list, first with the guide image as `colour = RASC / 2` (GX_CS_DIVIDE_2) and `alpha = KONST * (1 - TEXA)`, then with the players' canvas. The port's combiner sent lerp(a, 0, c) to GL_INTERPOLATE with a black constant that claimed the unit's one constant before KONST ("the first wins"), so the line drew at alpha 0; it is a modulate by the complement now, and the game's one DIVIDE_2 halves as a modulate by a 0.5 constant. The scores differ by the play (COM).

M34 control: unchanged by the day's levers. The caustic is the indirect warp (GXSetTevIndWarp: two indirect stages, each its own map, warping TEV stages 0 and 1), one shape with m417's ripple, recorded in PLAN.md 49.6 and not built (GL_ATI_text_fragment_shader exists on the G4 alone).

M34 (FIXED, PLAN.md 49.5): the tunnel's white cap was the IA8 byte order -- `fusagi`'s far-end quad is a two-palette CI8 whose GX_TL_IA8 entries the port read the wrong way round since M3 (alpha and intensity swapped), so the plug's alpha was its palette's intensity. The fall's timing is the play, not the clock: the START banner and the tunnel open on the same frame as the console's (49.5's timeline); the port lands before +2300 because every player is out (COM play), the console's own two captures ended at +2,742 and +2,422.

M34 (the streaks FIXED, PLAN.md 49.7): the fan of thin light quads from the raft was NaN water vertices -- the mesh build takes sqrtf((750 - r) * 0.01) for rim vertices out to r = 850, the square root of a negative number, which MSL's inline sqrtf returns unchanged on the console and libm made NaN; every game unit's sqrtf goes through the console's semantics now (include/msl_math.h). The boat sits in the water as the console's does. What remains is the pool's ripple: the indirect warp (three GXSetTevIndWarp stages over one bump map), PLAN.md 49.6, not built.

M34 (cause I FIXED, PLAN.md 49.3): the pillar spheres are drawn. The flare texture is IA8 and the port had read every IA8 texel with its two bytes the wrong way round since M3 (alpha is the high byte, as IA4's is the high nibble): the flare's star was in its alpha, so the port killed all but the star's texels and the cloud domes drawn after covered the ball; read the hardware's way the whole octagon passes the alpha test and writes Z, and the domes fail LEQUAL under the ball, as on the console. The z pre-pass M33 named was a red herring (49.2: the console's title says no to the ungated one; the ZCompLoc gate is on by the hardware's rule and md5-neutral).
